prompt: Read evals/files/review/unfinished/review-state.md and evals/files/review/unfinished/ai-usage.md. The implementation and tests still match the current description; only review activity changed. Decide whether a handled review round permits a description update. If it does not, leave the file unchanged and explain the exact unfinished conditions.
expected_output: The description is not updated because the review round is unfinished: one fix is pushed but unanswered, another comment remains unresolved, and a third comment is answered but its fix is not published. assertions: The AI Usage file remains unchanged.
The report does not claim that any review comment was handled.
The report identifies the unanswered reply and the unresolved comment as reasons no handled round exists.
The report identifies the answered comment whose fix is not published as a reason no handled round exists.
